title: ClaimRefusal
description: A claim refused for a reason other than that nothing is pending, which is no fault: what a worker's claims say on `refused` (contract/WORKER-CONTRACT.md § Claiming). `bus.unauthorized` means the credential cannot claim, and will not be able to later.

code.description: The bus code the reply was read as, or null when the refusal was the worker's own: a reply its schema does not allow. Never a code the reply did not state, and never `bus.none-pending`.
